workdir.read.linkOutside: {path} is a symbolic link that leads outside the working directory's folder: what it points at is not read
workdir.read.noFolder: The folder {root} is not there (or cannot be read)
workdir.read.none: This working directory is not read (readType: none)
workdir.read.notGit: The folder {root} of the working directory {name} is not a git repository (it has no .git). For readType: git, only the .gitignore files inside that folder were read
workdir.read.overLimit: Reading stopped at the limit of what is read ({limit}). Add what to leave out to exclude in how it is read
workdir.read.unbound: No folder is bound to it on this machine
workdir.text.notAFile: "{id}" is not a file of a working directory
workdir.text.outside: "{path}" is not a path inside the working directory
workdir.text.unreadable: Cannot read the file {path} (it is not there, or cannot be read)
